title: Geometric scheme-test charts with explicit scheme pullbacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:F\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $(Y_i\to Y)_{i\in I}$ a jointly surjective family of etale scheme charts [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family]. Suppose the given scheme charts $F_i\to F$ fit into cartesian squares $F_i=F\times_Y Y_i$, with projections $p_i:F_i\to Y_i$. For any scheme test $h:T\to Y$, there exist an algebraic space $X=F\times_Y T$, its projections and cartesian square, schemes $T_i=Y_i\times_Y T$ with both projections, their cartesian squares, and an etale jointly surjective family $T_i\to T$. Put $X_i=F_i\times_{Y_i}T_i$, taking the actual categorical scheme pullbacks with structure map through $F_i\to S$ and the two standard projections. There are etale jointly surjective maps $X_i\to X$ with cartesian squares $X_i=X\times_T T_i$, and their composites to $F$ equal $X_i\to F_i\to F$. If $h$ is etale then $X\to F$ is etale. The index universe is arbitrary.

source.place: Tags 02X2 and 025Y; spaces-topologies.tex Tag 041F (3); original preparation Step 1 and etale-projection part of Step 8.

proof.text: Form the algebraic-space fibre product and represent each base chart after the scheme test. Base change of the given cover gives the jointly surjective etale family of T_i.
Take the explicit scheme pullbacks F_i times_{Y_i} T_i. The universal property and pasting of the specified squares give their maps to X, the cartesian source squares, and the equation of maps to F.
Apply stability of the cover under base change to obtain etaleness and joint surjectivity of the source charts. When h is etale, its base change X to F is etale as well.

lean.statement: theorem exists_ampleSchemeTestCharts {S : Scheme.{u}} {F Y : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : F ⟶ Y) (I : Type v) (Yᵢ : I → Y.EtaleSite) (Fᵢ : I → F.EtaleSite) (pᵢ : ∀ i : I, (Fᵢ i).obj.left ⟶ (Yᵢ i).obj.left) (hcover : IsJointlySurjective (fun i : I ↦ (Yᵢ i).obj.hom)) (hpb : ∀ i : I, IsPullback (Fᵢ i).obj.hom (yoneda.map (pᵢ i)) f.hom.hom (Yᵢ i).obj.hom) (T : Over S) (h : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.obj.obj) : Nonempty (AmpleSchemeTestCharts f Yᵢ Fᵢ pᵢ T h)
